title: Introduction to Web Development
summary: This course introduces learners to HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript. Learners build simple web pages and understand how websites are structured.

title: JavaScript Fundamentals
summary: This course teaches variables, functions, arrays, loops, objects, and basic problem-solving with JavaScript.

title: React Application Development
summary: This course teaches learners how to build interactive interfaces using React components, props, state, events, and reusable UI patterns.

title: Node.js and Express APIs
summary: This course focuses on building server-side applications using Node.js and Express. Learners create routes, handle requests, and return JSON responses.

title: Databases for Web Applications
summary: This course introduces relational and document databases. Learners store, retrieve, update, and delete application data.

title: AI in Web Development
summary: This course explores how web developers can use AI APIs, prompt engineering, and AI-powered interfaces to build smarter applications.
